title: Installable desktop file editing
outcome: Install the desktop app, authorize a folder, edit and save a file, and recover an unsaved draft after restart.
contract_changes: Introduce validated local bootstrap, file operations, and draft persistence contracts.
migration_changes: Create initial workspace/file/draft metadata with explicit owners.

acceptance_checks.description: Reject invalid names and forbidden imports; print a correct repository map.
Exercise real safe save and detect an external version conflict.
Restart the application and recover an unsaved draft.
Install and launch the packaged app without external development runtimes.
